title: Atomic JSON recovery loses validated journal field types
description: mypy on generator consumers reports atomic_json.py target set.add receives Any|None and recovery coerces object with int(entry['mode']). _validated_journal returns generic dict[str, object] even after exact validation, so recovery relies on unchecked/coercive access rather than carrying a typed validated record. Preserve exact validated target/mode types (TypedDict or explicit typed copy), remove coercion, and rerun generator-wide mypy.
